snippet.title: Wilds -  Night Zookeeper Teaser
snippet.description:
Welcome to Wilds - Night Zookeeper, a multiplayer adventure where the creatures, stories, and chaos are created by you! WISHLIST on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3150750/Wilds__Night_Zookeeper/

Create completely original creatures using unique drawing and creation systems, then watch them become living, playable companions in a world of fast-paced multiplayer games, strange discoveries, and fantastic stories where anything can happen. 

From banana-farting monkeys to turtle-cars with laser eyes, if you can imagine it, you can create it!

COMING LATE 2026!
